items.title: fix(claimant): one verified-read server transport for every server call (#7770 Phase 2)
items.body: ## What Phase 2 (server seam) of the #7770 claimant seam contract: **one verified-read transport for every OpenCode server call in `claimant.py`**. - New `_server_request(method, path, body, timeout)` — the single authenticated transport (Basic auth from the same `OPENCODE_AUTH_FILE` credential `poll.py` uses). It returns `(http_status, parsed_body)`; the status is captured via `curl -w`, so a verdict never rests on curl's exit code (which is 0 on 401/404). - `_get_session` verdicts: `ok` (2xx + session object with an id), `gone` (**only** a 404 from the per-id GET), `unknown` (everything else — auth failure, 5xx, transport failure, mis-shaped body). Supervision leaves a task bound on `unknown`; it never reads as gone. - `_delete_session` counts only a verified 2xx — a failed DELETE can no longer clear a binding over a live session (the chained fail-open in #7367/#7760). - Session create is judged by status: a non-2xx create raises a transport failure, so the skip reason names it (`http status 401 (unauthorized)`) instead of `session_wrong_location` for a session that never existed. Cleanup deletes go through the same transport. - `_get_messages` / `_post_prompt` move onto the helper (singular `/message`; zero messages = 2xx + an actual list). Dead unauthenticated `_http_get` removed. No credential value is logged anywhere. ## Tests - The test stub is corrected to the writer's shapes: every stubbed curl reply carries its HTTP status as the trailing line, exactly as the real transport reads it; rc-based scenarios became status-based. - New #7367 acceptance tests: create-401 skip names the transport failure; session-GET 401 is unknown (left bound, no DELETE, no bind); DELETE 401 never clears the binding. - `python3 -m unittest pm-stack.opencode-claimant.test_claimant` — 21 tests OK. `test_poll` — 56 OK. ## Live verification (standing server, 127.0.0.1:13420) Missing session → `gone` (404 verdict); authenticated create → **200** with a session id (this always 401'd before); message read → verified `[]`; DELETE → 2xx; session afterwards → `gone`. Throwaway session was deleted in the same check. Fixes #7367 Fixes #7760 Part of #7770 (Phase 2 of 4; Phases 1 and 3 sub-issues already closed, Phase 4 audit #7772 remains) --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? items.title: claimant: #7770 Phase 4 closing audit — seam contract, fire-log unknowns, stub-shape fix (#7772)
items.body: Phase 4 (closing audit) of design #7770 — act only on a verified read — for issue #7772. Queue task 14782, lane code-y. ## What lands - **README — Seam Contract section** beside #4916's session contract: the verified-read rule, the three seam decisions, the Phase 4 seam inventory (claimant.py's queue/CLI/gh reads and both queue seams; server calls cross-referenced to #4916's landed inventory, not duplicated), the stub-shape audit, and required dispositions (a)–(e) with evidence. - **claimant.py fire-log measurements (#7732 contract, found by this audit):** the cap-unknown exit now logs `cap_room: null` instead of the internal `-1` sentinel; a failed candidate discovery now exits as `gate_unknown` with `candidates_seen: null` instead of being logged identically to a verified empty queue (`gate_step` returns `None` on discovery failure). Two new tests pin both. Header comments that cited the server seam as "decision 3" corrected to Decision 2. - **Stub-shape fix:** `test/test_claimant.py`'s curl stub mirrored the reader's pre-#7770 assumption (bare bodies, no HTTP status) — the #7760 defect class; 2 of its 5 tests failed against the verified transport. The stub now mirrors the writer (curl `-w` status trailer, rc 0 on HTTP errors, the v2 server's 404 error body) and its docstring names the writer. - **prompt.md:** stale queue-CLI path constants (`~/fleet-brokers/bin/repo-queue`, retired by the code#5362 cutover) repaired to `~/.local/bin/repo-queue` in both places; the backend-outage section's stripped tokens restored. ## Dispositions recorded on #7772 (a) Verb trio #7349/#7355/#7358: independent of the landed channel, per verb. (b) #7735: not a phase of #7770; the claimant has no use for by-id claim. (c) #4916 boundary: resolved by cross-reference (it landed first). (d) #6533: re-scoped to live-fire verification with the Phase 1 evidence chain recorded on it. (e) prompt.md generation: YES — filed as #8366. Residuals (poll.py per-queue unknown marker, supervision fire-log silence) are owned by open #8042; the channel divergence from Decision 1's letter (broker rich read landed instead of CLI JSON) is recorded on #7770. ## Tests Laptop, worktree at this head: `python3 -m unittest test_poll test_claimant` — 80 passed; `python3 -m unittest discover -s test` — 5 passed (was 2 failures pre-fix); `test_dispatch_batch test_launch_one test_send_to_opencode` — 50 passed. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR?
